basic_details.job_title: DLSA Bijnor Peon Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: District Legal Services Authority, Bijnor (DLSA Bijnor) has announced 1 vacancy for the Peon post on a contract basis. Eligible candidates can apply through the offline mode by sending the application by registered post or by hand at the Office of District Legal Services Authority, Civil Court Campus, Bijnor on or before 31 October 2026. Applicants for the Peon post must be a Retired Civil Court / Collectorate employee. The notified pay for the post is Rs. 7,000, and the selection process involves academic merit, work efficiency, and an interview under recruitment advertisement number 0716/DLS

qualification.details: Qualification Required: Must be a retired employee from the Civil Court or Collectorate/judicial office. | Age Limit: 2 years or up to 65 years of age, whichever is completed first.

selection_process: The selection process for the Peon post is based on academic merit
and an interview conducted by the committee.
important_instructions: The applicant must be a citizen of India. Candidates must not have more than one living spouse. Applicants must not have been convicted in any criminal case by any court. No TA/DA or allowance will be paid for attending the test or interview. Incomplete or unsigned application forms will be summarily rejected. Applications must reach the office by 31 October 2026 at 5:00 PM through registered post or hand delivery; incorrect addresses or delayed submissions will not be considered. Candidates can download the application format from the official website of the District Court Bijnor or Allahabad High Court.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates must submit their applications in a sealed envelope containing all required self-attested educational, identity, address, and character certificate copies, along with self-attested photographs. The application can be deposited by hand at the office or sent via registered post. Postal Address: Office of District Legal Services Authority, Civil Court Campus, Bijnor, Uttar Pradesh, PIN - 246701
